subject: general
question: A sum becomes Rs.26,400 after 2 years at simple interest of 5% per annum. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 26400

Time = 2 years

Rate = 5%

**Formula used:**

Amount = P + SI

S.I = (P × t × r)/100

P = Principal

t = Time

r = Rate of interest

**Calculation:**

P + (P × 2 × 5)/100 = 26400

⇒ P + P/10 = 26400

⇒ 11P/10 = 26400

⇒ P = 26400 × 10/11

⇒ P = Rs. 24000 

**∴ The sum is Rs. 24000 **
